comment: Coverage floors for the CI unit-coverage job, mirrored into the coverage:check npm script and guarded by test/unit/coverage_thresholds_sync.test.js. Measured 2026-09-23 with c8 --all and no source exclusions: 71.92 lines/statements, 87.02 branches, and 66.08 functions over 1003 passing tests with 4 pending. These regression floors sit 1.42, 1.42, and 0.78 points below the respective measurements.
